paragraphs: On a hot Thursday, the club hour was in the school gym. Coach Matt put a small tent in the middle of the floor. He had a silver whistle on a cord around his neck. Tom came to help, and he carried a big box of bands.

Half of the children got a blue band, and half got a yellow band. "Listen to the rules," said Coach Matt. "If your band is blue, you walk around the tent." "If your band is yellow, you jump on one foot." "If you hear the whistle, you stop." "If you move after the whistle, you are out." Lily had a yellow band, and Mia and Leo had blue bands.

The game began, and the gym was full of noise. It was a fun game. Tom put the empty box by the wall and walked away. Mia walked around the tent with a big smile. Lily jumped on one foot, and her friends laughed. Then Coach Matt blew the whistle. Everybody stopped, but Leo did not hear it, and he walked one more step. "Leo, you are out," said Coach Matt kindly. Leo sat on the floor, and he looked unhappy.

Suddenly, there was a strange sound inside the tent. "Ooooh!" said the tent. Everybody looked at it. "What is that?" asked Mia. Leo stood up and walked slowly to the tent. He opened it, and Tom was inside with a small flashlight under his face. "I am a ghost!" said Tom. Leo laughed so much that he forgot the game. He felt better now.

"That is a good joke, Tom," said Coach Matt. "Now hurry, everybody, because it is time to go outside." "If the sun is hot, we wear a hat," he said. "If you stay in the sun without a hat, your skin can burn." Lily put on her hat and took Leo's arm. "Come on, Leo," she said. "You are not out of the club." Leo smiled, and the Explorers ran out into the bright field.
